UpCloud.summary_note: UpCloud presents a superior 'Clean Jurisdictional' profile compared to IONOS because it lacks a US-based parent or subsidiary with authority over EU operations, nullifying direct CLOUD Act exposure (SOV2-Q2/Q3 are both Y). Its primary weakness in this framework is Technology Sovereignty (SOV-6): its core performance differentiator, MaxIOPS, is a closed-source Finnish technology (verdict N/P). While this is European IP, it prevents the level of 'audit and modification' found in OpenStack-based systems like T-Systems. Strategically, it is a SEAL-level choice for EU public sector entities (Helsinki's 2026 adoption serves as proof), but hardware dependencies (AMD/NVIDIA) remain a collective EU 'Partial' mark in 2026.
